annotations.title: Find the transits to a birth chart on a date

description:
Computes where the sky is on a chosen date against where it was at somebody's birth: ten transiting bodies with longitude, sign, degree, speed and retrograde state, and every aspect they make to the natal planets and angles, each with its orb, the orb allowed, the natal longitude measured against, and whether the contact is applying or separating. It covers what is transiting a chart, whether a transit is active on a date, a Saturn return, or whether a contact has perfected.

The computation takes two full sets of ecliptic longitudes (the birth instant, at the historic UTC offset of that place and date, and the target instant), then the angle between every pair taken the short way round the circle: about a hundred and fifty separations, each with a wrap case at 0 Aries. A contact is applying when its orb shrinks over the following hour, and separating when it grows.

The orb convention is in result.orbConvention. How close a transit has to be to count is a convention, and an aspect list without its orb cannot be checked. Here: 3 degrees for conjunction, opposition, trine and square, 2 for sextile, deliberately tighter than a natal chart's 8.

With "time" left out for an unknown birth time, the ascendant and midheaven are dropped entirely, because a transit to an angle cast for an arbitrary noon has no meaning. The Moon is included, where most software excludes it; the lunar nodes are excluded. Significance is interpretation and is not computed here.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

at.description: Time of day for the transit, HH:MM, read as UTC. Example: "12:00". Defaults to 00:00 UTC.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1800-2200. Example: "1977-10-19". The sky is read for the date in "on".

lat.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "39.76838". Paired with lon.

lon.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees as a string. Example: "-86.15804". Paired with lat.

on.description: Date to read the sky for, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1700-2200. Example: today's date for "what is transiting me now".

place.description: Town or city of birth with region or country. Example: "Indianapolis, Indiana, United States".

time.description: Birth time HH:MM local at the birthplace. Example: "23:58". Optional; when it is absent the angles are dropped.

tz.description: IANA zone or numeric UTC offset hours for the birth moment. Example: "-5". When absent, resolved historically.
